integration_issues.issue: Acceptance asked for exactly 1 <video> element on /, but document.querySelectorAll('video').length = 0. Root [data-testid=home-hero-avatar] IS present (innerHTML 21k chars) but contains no <video>. Avatar console logs show readyState:0, networkState:3 (NETWORK_NO_SOURCE) for src=master-intro-opt.mp4. Likely root cause: REACT_APP_AVATAR_CDN_BASE=--- in /app/frontend/.env is literally three dashes — not a valid URL — so the video src resolves to '---/master-intro-opt.mp4' and the <video> element either never renders or gets removed after load failure. NOTE: This iteration (102c) ONLY touched substring renames + F-class lint cleanups; it did NOT modify avatar code, so this is a pre-existing env config issue, not a 102c regression. All other avatar acceptance criteria pass (home-hero-avatar root present, 0 audio elements, buffering overlay 0/8 samples).
